`npm test` is green again: all 517 tests pass. Two commits since `v2.0.0` caused the 8 failures, and I fixed both in the source without touching any tests.

- **`958d3ae` (thousands separators):** in `src/money.js`, the cents part of `formatMoney` was padded with `padEnd` instead of `padStart`. That turned `$0.01` into `$0.10`. I changed it back to `padStart`, and the thousands separators are kept.
- **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork):** in `src/invoice.js`, `taxable` was set to the full subtotal, so tax ignored order-level codes like SPRING10. It is now `subtotal - discount`. Line discounts are still handled correctly, because they are already inside the subtotal.

I haven't committed the changes.
